# Left-back shortlist: pressing and progression

_Generated 2026-09-30 for the recruitment meeting on 3 October 2026._

## Summary

We screened 214 [C1] left-backs in the top 5 European leagues for the 2025/26 season, with a
floor of 900 [C2] minutes. Three names stand out.

1. **Player A** (Reep ID `reep_p8812ab`) leads the sample in progressive carries per 90 at
   4.7 [C3], and 61% [C4] of his pressures come in the opposition half.
2. **Player B** posts 0.21 [C5] npxG+xA per 90, the highest of any full-back with at least
   2,010 minutes [C6].
3. **Player C** is the cheapest option; his club lost 2-1 and 3–0 in the two matches we
   watched, but his numbers held: 1,284 [C7] passes completed at 88.4% [C8].

## Method

Per 90 rates use minutes from Opta (`qualifier 213` is not used). Pressures follow the
StatsBomb definition (see [the docs](https://docs.example.org/v4/events#pressure-17)).
Season 2024-25 is used only as a sanity check.

Player A's high-press share is consistent with a team that defends high [C9].
